fields.headline: Bleed a radiator in four steps
fields.summary: Cold at the top, warm at the bottom? Trapped air. Ten minutes and a radiator key fix it.

media.alt: Hand holding a radiator key against a valve

steps.name: Turn the heating off
steps.text: Switch the central heating off and let the radiator cool completely.

steps.name: Open the bleed valve
steps.text: Hold the bowl under the valve and turn the key counter-clockwise a quarter turn — you'll hear a hiss.

steps.name: Wait for water
steps.text: When the hissing stops and a steady trickle of water appears, all the air is out.

steps.name: Close and check pressure
steps.text: Close the valve, turn the heating back on and top up the boiler pressure if it dropped below 1 bar.
